name: dev-workflow
description: Reusable AI-assisted development workflow: topic documentation skills (topic-init / topic-plan / topic-test / topic-status), doc verification gates, doc conciseness review, workflow self-correction, repo adoption onboarding (workflow-adopt), plus the 19 AI-assisted development principles as reference docs. Repo-agnostic — adopting repos follow the docs/ref/<MODULE>/<TOPIC>/ convention and adapt path/command examples to their own layout.
